1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that does not harm the viability of the embryos; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme, wherein the enzyme is selected from the group consisting of VISCOZYME@ and other cell wall degrading enzymes.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos that retain viability during the analysis.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a quiescent condition prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping based on DNA obtained from the shed cellular material.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype analysis results obtained from the molecular analysis. 

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos after selection based on genotype analysis. 

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated, wherein the automation includes the use of software for analysis and selection.
